invariants.rule: A meaningful required term stays required even when corpus df = 0.
Explicit source selectors remain hard filters. Retrieve rank cannot override them.
Ambiguous source selectors cause silence. No type-preference fallback.
Failed, scanned, refused, or empty named documents never fall back to another PDF.
Subject compatibility applies to the actual spoken claim / mapped range, not page title, outline, neighbor chunk, or unmapped metadata.
Predicate compatibility is required. shape=what is not a pass-through.
Enumeration remains coherent and page-local. Headings and single members are not lists.
Unknown relations fail closed. Prefer silence over an unrecognized predicate.
Thread resolves source references only. It does not satisfy subject, predicate, answer type, or support.
Evidence support remains the final safety check. Currentness and word-level support stay last.
No embeddings are ever used as proof that a passage answers a question.
